name: Amos 4D Craft
summary: At the beginning, the players will be spawned on an isolated islands. Players need to go to the candy kingdom to fight monsters, mine or PVP with other players to obtain resources through their own efforts. The players can buy all kinds of gummy blocks and candy seeds in the store to build and develop the island; They can also buy all kinds of candy armor or privileges to arm himself and build his island into a super candy kingdom! The players can invite their friends freely from all over the world to party on his island. They can earn points from building islands and can be ranked on the leaderboard with higher points against other players and therefore gain a higher exposure rate of the structures they built.
